concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-tokens-digital-wallet-authentication-data]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Issuing guide for phone/email authentication data and OTP during digital-wallet card addition; its creation-time wording is qualified by the later card-update route.
warnings: The opening says to include authentication data when issuing a card, but line 603 expressly allows adding it later with a payment-instrument update.
